messages.content: Find a picnic spot in Miami.

function.name: local_fauna
function.description: Get information about fauna in a specified region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The region or area to find information about.

species_type.description: Type of species e.g birds, mammals etc. for detailed information.

migration_season.description: Season when fauna migrate e.g spring, winter, none. Default is none.

message.content:
Sure! If you’re looking for a great place to enjoy a picnic in Miami, consider **South Pointe Park**. ### Why South Pointe Park? | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Location** | 1 Biscayne Blvd, Miami Beach, FL 33139 (just south of downtown Miami) | | **Scenic Views** | Overlooks the Atlantic Ocean, Fisher Island, and the Miami skyline – perfect for sunset picnics. | | **Amenities** | • Picnic tables & shaded pavilions
• Restrooms & showers
• Playground for kids
• Walking paths along the waterfront | | **Accessibility** | Easy access via I‑95 and public transit; ample parking nearby. | | **Best Time** | Early afternoon to catch the sunset (around 7–8 pm). | ### Nearby Attractions - **Miami Beach Boardwalk** – stroll after your meal. - **Lummus Park** – another beachfront option if you want more space. - **Bayfront Park** – great for a larger group or family gathering. ### Tips - Bring a blanket or rent a picnic table from the park’s visitor center. - Pack a cooler with drinks, sandwiches, and a portable speaker for music. - Check the weather forecast; Miami can get breezy near the water. Enjoy your picnic!
